title: The Best Low Budget Online Business To Start Right Now
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The tutorial promotes HighLevel as the execution platform and highlights its free templates; no sponsorship or affiliate disclosure is stated.

idea.name: Database reactivation service
idea.one_liner: Reactivate small businesses’ past customers through campaigns and automations, charging a fee or share of generated revenue.
idea.offer: Set up and run reactivation campaigns, follow-ups, and offer tests using the client’s customer list.
idea.revenue_model: Suggested performance share, fixed campaign fee, or free initial campaign followed by paid upsells; recurring work is mentioned but not priced.

key_quotes.quote: To break it down in simple terms, it's taking a customer list from a small business and reactivating them to drive more revenue or just emailing and/or texting them to drive more revenue.
And any revenue that we generate from that list, you just give us 10% of.
You take 10% of that as the agency owner, and you make four grand just for sending an email using a template that High Level gives you for free.

ideas.delivery: The provider imports the client’s contact list, configures HighLevel workflows and messages, tests offers, monitors analytics, and shares results with the client. Replies and booking links can be automated.

prices: No fee if no revenue is generated
Trim two trees, get the third free

uk_legal_risk.reason: The workflow explicitly allows marketing texts to a client’s past-customer list, which may include individuals. The transcript does not mention consent or a qualifying soft opt-in; UK PECR restricts unsolicited marketing texts to individuals and sole traders.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to importing and using customer data; PECR also governs electronic direct marketing and opt-outs. The transcript does not describe consent, soft-opt-in, or suppression-list checks.
